race.comment: MISS TRENTINO (7) returned from an 11-month absence with an encouraging effort in a similar race here two weeks ago, only tiring in the shadows after racing up on the pace. Won three straight this time last year and looks ready to recapture that form. TAXATION (12) is back after a six-month break. Failed at the only run last prep when all was not right. Started at $3.70 against a class mare in Weeping Woman last November but was at the end of her prep and disappointed. Has plenty of talent and is a big market watch. MELANITE (5) overcame an awkward start to just get the cash over this distance in a Randwick Midway recently. That form should measure right up here. Draws the fence so another big run is likely.  RUINATION (1) races for the first time in six months. Has always showed ability and is now a gelding so he might go to another level this prep. ZALE (3) is a model of consistency and can never be left out of a race like this.
